big_case.notes: Post-AFPF challenge to a state electioneering-communication donor-disclosure law, a published divided Tenth Circuit opinion, four cert-stage amici, a response request after waiver, and the Court denied silently on the long-conference order list with no noted dissent. A grant would have reached every state's pre-election disclosure regime, but no split was claimed, the vehicle was contested, and the realized disposition drew no writing. Middle of the elevated band: more than a routine paid petition, well short of a headline case. Formed from the record and outcome; the staged prediction.json carries each candidate's score, so I could not avoid seeing them, but this read was set from the docket and briefs rather than from those numbers.
